title: Revenue shows a negative figure when credits exceed sales
pre_body:
Preconditions

  1. User: you are signed in as a user whose role has the Reports permission (for example Admin).
  2. Browser: you use a desktop browser window at least 1024 pixels wide (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  3. Location: you are in a location (workplace) where no invoice has been created today.
  4. Location: That location has an invoice from an earlier day with a part on it (e.g. a part with Sell Price $160.00).
